# Cypress Visual Tester Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Cypress

## Overview

Implements visual regression testing with Cypress using Percy, Applitools, or cypress-image-snapshot for UI consistency verification

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cypress-visual-tester-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cypress-visual-tester-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cypress-visual-tester` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure visual testing with Percy or Applitools
- Capture and compare visual snapshots
- Implement responsive visual testing across viewports
- Handle dynamic content in visual tests

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Percy**: Visual testing platform integration
- **Visual Regression**: Screenshot comparison methodology
- **Responsive Testing**: Multi-viewport visual verification
